Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Build and send the survey results email. Runs on FileMaker Server via Perform Script on Server.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PARAMETER (JSON): to, textBody, itemsHTML, score, grade

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: RESULT (JSON): ok = 1 on success, or ok = 0 with error and detail

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: The server session has no $$ variables from the user's session - everything it needs arrives in the parameter or comes from _globals

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Build the HTML part of the email

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Logo from _globals::Logo - embedded in the email so mail apps show it without loading remote images

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Base64 in 76-character lines, as email requires

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Logo row for the HTML - shown at up to 180 pixels wide, keeping its proportions

Value.Calculation:
"" & ¶ & "
" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & $logoRow & "" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & "" & ¶ & "
Survey Results
You received a score of " & $score & " out of 40 possible points and a grade of " & "" & $grade & "
A list of suggested improvement items is listed below:
" & ¶ & $itemsHTML & "
" & ¶ & "

To learn more about building strong security policies, read our blog post Cybersecurity Policies, Part 1.

" & ¶ & "

MC Services would love to help you with your organization's cybersecurity.

" & ¶ & "

Call (800) 453-8106, email us at info@mcservices.com, or visit mcservices.com

" & ¶ & "

Book a time to talk

" & ¶ & "
Have a wonderful day from the team at MC Services
"

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Mail settings - read from the _globals table

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Build the MIME message - SMTP needs CR+LF line endings

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: With a logo: multipart/related holding the text+HTML alternatives plus the image. Without: text+HTML only.

Value.Calculation: Let ( [ alt = "MCS_ALT_BOUNDARY" ; rel = "MCS_REL_BOUNDARY" ; headers = "From: MC Services Survey <" & $from & ">" & ¶ & "To: " & $to & ¶ & "Reply-To: info@mcservices.com" & ¶ & "Subject: " & $subject & ¶ & "MIME-Version: 1.0" & ¶ ; alternatives = "--" & alt & ¶ & "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8" & ¶ & "Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit" & ¶ & ¶ & $textBody & ¶ & ¶ & "--" & alt & ¶ & "Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8" & ¶ & "Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit" & ¶ & ¶ & $html & ¶ & ¶ & "--" & alt & "--" & ¶ ; msg = If ( $hasLogo ; headers & "Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary=\"" & rel & "\"" & ¶ & ¶ & "--" & rel & ¶ & "Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary=\"" & alt & "\"" & ¶ & ¶ & alternatives & ¶ & "--" & rel & ¶ & "Content-Type: " & $logoMime & "; name=\"" & $logoFile & "\"" & ¶ & "Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64" & ¶ & "Content-ID: <mcslogo>" & ¶ & "Content-Disposition: inline; filename=\"" & $logoFile & "\"" & ¶ & ¶ & $logoBase64 & ¶ & "--" & rel & "--" & ¶ ; headers & "Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary=\"" & alt & "\"" & ¶ & ¶ & alternatives ) ] ; Substitute ( msg ; ¶ ; Char ( 13 ) & Char ( 10 ) ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Stop early with a clear message if anything needed is missing

Step.name: Exit Script
Exit Script
# (comment)
Step.Text: Bcc copies go to duane@ and sales@ - recipients without a To/Cc header are blind copies

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Send - port 587 is STARTTLS, so smtp:// plus --ssl-reqd

Step.name: Exit Script
